errors.text_span: with counts remaining low (1–2 datasets per year)
errors.evidence: This statement generalizes the counts for the years 2012 to 2016. While the value is 1-2 for 2012-2013, it is approximately 3 for 2014-2015 and approximately 12 for 2016. The range (1-2) is therefore incorrect for most of this period.
